authority: Candidate: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
interpretation: This packet records first-party source observations for reviewer use. It does not approve an authority, opportunity, eligibility rule, benefit, window, or publication status.
sourcePolicy: Official Gazette, ministry or implementing-agency pages only; third-party claims are excluded.

records.sourceAnchor: S.O. 2046(E), 8 May 2025; Chapters I-V: commencement, objective, definitions, eligible borrowers and Member Institutions
observations: The 8 May 2025 notification identifies the Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS) as a DPIIT scheme for credit guarantees on loans extended by Member Institutions to eligible startups.
The notification states that it supersedes the earlier 6 October 2022 notification.
The benefit must remain represented as loan-linked credit-guarantee support rather than a direct grant or automatic loan entitlement.
reviewFollowUps: Reconcile the current scheme guideline, Member Institution route, lender conditions and any subsequent amendment before publication.
Verify the record's DPIIT-recognition, borrower, facility, default/NPA and guarantee-coverage rules against the complete notification and current operational source.
Confirm the current Jan Samarth and NCGTC routes and record any route-specific document or window changes.

records.sourceAnchor: Startup India Investor Connect: purpose, launch and investor-startup engagement description
observations: The official Startup India page describes Investor Connect as a platform connecting startups and investors.
The page states that the initiative was launched at the sixth National Startup Advisory Council meeting on 11 March 2023.
The record should remain a non-financial market-access or investor-connection opportunity and must not imply funding approval or guaranteed investment.
reviewFollowUps: Verify the current authenticated application route, profile requirements, investor-hosted opportunity flow and any request limits.
Confirm whether the dashboard entry and current platform operation remain available to the intended startup profile.

records.sourceAnchor: Startup India National Mentorship Platform; Startup Application; Get a Mentor; Key Functions of MAARG Program
observations: The official MAARG portal identifies itself as the Startup India National Mentorship Platform under DPIIT and the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
The portal provides separate startup and mentor application routes and describes matching and mentor-startup interaction functions.
The record should remain a mentorship and guidance opportunity, not a grant, loan, investment, or guaranteed business outcome.
reviewFollowUps: Verify current startup eligibility, application fields, cohort route, matching availability and platform terms.
Confirm that the current portal and contact route are operational at the time of human publication review.
